title: 'The Interview': Arundhati Roy Knows Where America Is Headed

sentences.zh: 我曾在凌晨4点半给总统打电话，他接听了。

sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia-Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: As we get older, we often struggle to untangle the impact our parents have on our lives.
sentences.zh: 随着年龄增长，我们常常难以理清父母对我们生活的影响。

sentences.en: For acclaimed author Arundhati Roy, that process of excavation happened after her mother's death in 2022 through writing.
sentences.zh: 对于广受赞誉的作家阿兰达蒂·罗伊来说，这种挖掘过程是在她母亲2022年去世后，通过写作完成的。

sentences.en: Her new memoir, Mother Mary Comes to Me, is more than just a chronicle of her complex relationship with her mother, whose bouts of clawing, lashing fury, as Roy describes it,
sentences.zh: 她的新回忆录《玛丽母亲来到我身边》不仅仅是对她与母亲复杂关系的记录，正如罗伊所描述的那样，她母亲时而爆发的抓挠和猛烈怒火，

sentences.en: scarred both her and her brother.
sentences.zh: 给她和她哥哥都留下了创伤。

sentences.en: It's also about Roy herself and why she's become a writer transfixed by the pain and suffering of those around her.
sentences.zh: 这本书也关乎罗伊本人，以及为什么她会成为一名被周围人的痛苦和苦难所吸引的作家。

sentences.en: Roy has spent her career writing about the rich lives and deep struggles of marginalized and oppressed people in India.
sentences.zh: 罗伊的职业生涯一直致力于书写印度边缘化和受压迫群体的丰富生活与深重苦难。

sentences.en: Her Booker Prize-winning first novel, The God of Small Things, has sold over six million copies and made her an international literary star when it came out in 1997.
sentences.zh: 她凭借处女作《微物之神》赢得了布克奖，该书销量超过六百万册，并在1997年出版时使她成为国际文坛明星。

sentences.en: What followed over the next several decades were dozens of articles pointing her pen at a range of injustices, from India's caste system to the treatment of Muslims,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几十年里，她撰写了数十篇文章，将笔触指向一系列不公，从印度的种姓制度到对穆斯林的对待，

sentences.en: especially in Indian-controlled Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 特别是在印度控制的克什米尔地区。

sentences.en: Both her work and her person have been repeatedly targeted by India's government under populist leader Narendra Modi.
sentences.zh: 她的作品和她本人都多次受到印度民粹主义领导人纳伦德拉·莫迪政府的针对。

sentences.en: And she's currently facing possible prosecution under anti-terrorism laws for comments she made years ago about the territorial conflict in Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 目前，她还因多年前就克什米尔领土冲突发表的言论，面临着反恐法下的起诉风险。

sentences.en: When we spoke, we started with her mother's story.
sentences.zh: 当我们交谈时，我们从她母亲的故事开始。

sentences.en: But in our second conversation, she talked about the cost of speaking out and her fears for America under President Trump.
sentences.zh: 但在我们的第二次谈话中，她谈到了直言不讳的代价，以及她对特朗普总统治下美国的担忧。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with author Arundhati Roy.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与作家阿兰达蒂·罗伊的对话。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 你好，露露。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm very well.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for coming on to the interview.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你来参加这次访谈。

sentences.en: I'm very pleased to have you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能邀请到你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: This book really resonated with me.
sentences.zh: 这本书真的引起了我的共鸣。

sentences.en: It's a memoir of you, but also a biography of your mother, who died in 2022 at the age of 89.
sentences.zh: 这既是你的回忆录，也是你母亲的传记，她于2022年去世，享年89岁。

sentences.en: And she was a very complicated and difficult person, as you describe her.
sentences.zh: 正如你所描述的，她是一个非常复杂且难以相处的人。

sentences.en: While I was reading it, it reminded me of this quote by the writer Czeslav Milos, who wrote, When a writer is born into the family, the family is finished.
sentences.zh: 阅读时，我想起了作家切斯瓦夫·米沃什的一句名言：“当一个家庭里诞生了一位作家，这个家庭就完了。”

sentences.en: Did you struggle with how much to reveal about your mother and your family, just in the personal context of how difficult your upbringing actually was?
sentences.zh: 在个人成长的艰难背景下，你是否曾纠结于该揭露多少关于你母亲和家庭的事情？

sentences.en: Well, obviously, you know, when you write something like this, you choose what you write and what you won't write.
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然，你知道，当你写这样的东西时，你会选择写什么，不写什么。

sentences.en: But I know that this doesn't work as literature.
sentences.zh: 但我知道，如果那样做，文学性就没了。

sentences.en: If you're trying to present some acceptable version of yourself or of her, then you might as well not do it, you know.
sentences.zh: 如果你试图呈现一个关于你自己或她的“可接受”版本，那还不如不写，你知道吧。

sentences.en: But to me, it wasn't so much of a struggle because I think what was incredible about her was that there was a part of her which hammered me, but then it also created me.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，这并没有太大的挣扎，因为我认为她不可思议的地方在于，她身上有一部分在摧毁我，但同时也塑造了我。

sentences.en: But then there was this public part of her which was so extraordinary, you know.
sentences.zh: 但她身上还有那种非常非凡的公众形象，你知道。

sentences.en: So I could never settle on what I really thought or felt.
sentences.zh: 所以我永远无法确定自己到底是怎么想的，或者感受如何。

sentences.en: I could never remove myself from her because I admired her too.
sentences.zh: 我永远无法将自己从她身边剥离，因为我也钦佩她。

sentences.en: And I just felt that the entire range of what she had was a challenge to me as a writer.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得她所拥有的一切，对我这个作家来说都是一种挑战。

sentences.en: Can I put down this unresolvable character?
sentences.zh: 我能写下这个无法解决的人物吗？

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about Mary Roy and that public part of her before we get to the part of her as your mother.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在我们谈论她作为你母亲的那一面之前，先聊聊玛丽·罗伊和她公众形象的那一面。

sentences.en: I mean, on the most basic level, tell me about who she was outside of your relationship.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在最基本的层面上，告诉我她在你们的关系之外是一个怎样的人。

sentences.en: I mean, she was indeed a well-known person.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她确实是一个知名人物。

sentences.en: She belonged to the Syrian Christian community in Kerala, which is a pretty tiny but privileged community
sentences.zh: 她属于喀拉拉邦的叙利亚基督教社区，那是一个规模很小但享有特权的社区，

sentences.en: that's insulated from the wildness and the poverty of the rest of India for many reasons.
sentences.zh: 由于种种原因，它与印度其他地区的狂野和贫困隔绝开来。

sentences.en: But then she married outside the community and then got divorced, which was absolute taboo, you know.
sentences.zh: 但后来她嫁给了社区外的人，又离了婚，这在当时是绝对的禁忌，你知道。

sentences.en: And she started a small school initially in the rented premises of what was called the Rotary Club.
sentences.zh: 她最初在租来的所谓“扶轮社”场所开了一所小学校。

sentences.en: I used to think of it as a sliding folding school because we had to sweep up all the stubs and the coffee cups of the men
sentences.zh: 我过去常把它称为“折叠学校”，因为我们必须清扫男人们留下的烟蒂和咖啡杯，

sentences.en: and put out our furniture and then they would come the next day and mess it up again.
sentences.zh: 摆好我们的家具，然后他们第二天又会来把这里弄乱。

sentences.en: And then ultimately built this beautiful school, which still runs.
sentences.zh: 最终，她建成了这所美丽的学校，至今仍在运营。

sentences.en: I studied there too in the early years.
sentences.zh: 早年我也在那里学习过。

sentences.en: But what she's equally well-known for is that when she left her husband, my father,
sentences.zh: 但她同样出名的是，当她离开我的父亲时，

sentences.en: we lived in this tiny little cottage that used to belong to her very cruel father, who was dead by then.
sentences.zh: 我们住在一个属于她那位非常残忍的父亲的小屋里，他当时已经去世了。

sentences.en: And then her mother and her older brother came there and they asked us to leave the house.
sentences.zh: 然后她的母亲和哥哥来到那里，要求我们搬走。

sentences.en: And they said that as a daughter, according to the Travancore Christian Succession Act,
sentences.zh: 他们说，根据《特拉凡哥尔基督教继承法》，

sentences.en: a daughter can inherit a quarter of her father's property or 5,000 rupees, whichever is less.
sentences.zh: 女儿只能继承父亲财产的四分之一或5000卢比，以较少者为准。

sentences.en: So we were literally going to be turfed out onto this road in the middle of the night by my grandmother and my uncle.
sentences.zh: 所以我们差点在半夜被祖母和舅舅赶到街上去。

sentences.en: And she and we ran to the lawyer and he told us that law applies in Kerala, not in Tamil Nadu.
sentences.zh: 她带着我们跑去找律师，律师告诉我们那条法律在喀拉拉邦适用，但在泰米尔纳德邦不适用。

sentences.en: So we weren't kicked out.
sentences.zh: 所以我们没有被赶走。

sentences.en: But she nurtured this humiliation and kept it to herself for a long time.
sentences.zh: 但她把这份屈辱埋在心里，忍了很久。

sentences.en: But when she was able to, when she was economically stable, when she could afford to, she filed appeal to the Supreme Court,
sentences.zh: 当她有能力时，当她经济稳定、负担得起时，她向最高法院提起上诉，

sentences.en: challenging this law, you know, calling it unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 挑战这项法律，称其违宪。

sentences.en: And the Supreme Court actually struck down that law with retrospective effect and made it equal inheritance for everybody.
sentences.zh: 最高法院最终废除了那项法律，并具有追溯效力，实现了所有人的平等继承权。

sentences.en: And it took years and years and years and years in court, you know, before she actually won the case.
sentences.zh: 这在法庭上耗费了漫长的岁月，你知道，她才最终赢得了官司。

sentences.en: And she had very few people on her side while she was fighting it.
sentences.zh: 在她抗争的时候，几乎没有人站在她这一边。

sentences.en: So there's that side of your mother.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是你母亲的那一面。

sentences.en: You start the book, though, really discussing how you were raised by her.
sentences.zh: 不过，你书的开头确实讨论了你是如何被她抚养长大的。

sentences.en: And your early life, as you describe it, was one of hardship, poverty, instability, and abuse, both verbal and physical.
sentences.zh: 正如你所描述的，你的早年生活充满了艰辛、贫困、动荡和虐待，包括言语和身体上的。

sentences.en: I should ask before we continue, is abusive actually the word that feels right to you in describing your relationship to her?
sentences.zh: 在继续之前我应该问一下，“虐待”这个词用在描述你们的关系上，你觉得合适吗？

sentences.en: I flinch, you know, when we use these words, because nowadays there are a lot of these words that are used and I suppose they are useful in some ways.
sentences.zh: 当我们使用这些词时，我会退缩，你知道，因为现在有很多这样的词被使用，我想它们在某些方面是有用的。

sentences.en: But I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道。

sentences.en: I didn't use any of these words in the book.
sentences.zh: 我在书中没有使用任何这些词。

sentences.en: And if it was a single thing that one was dealing with, you know, if it was just abuse or just violence or just one thing that you could settle on and decide how to feel about it,
sentences.zh: 如果是一个单一的问题，你知道，如果只是虐待，或者只是暴力，或者只是你可以确定并决定如何感受的一件事，

sentences.en: that's one thing.
sentences.zh: 那是一回事。

sentences.en: But I think I had a schism in me very early where even as a young child,
sentences.zh: 但我认为我内心很早就产生了一种分裂，即使在孩提时代，

sentences.en: I could see that her anger against me and my brother was somehow connected to what she herself was going through.
sentences.zh: 我也能看出她对我和我哥哥的愤怒，在某种程度上与她自己正在经历的事情有关。

sentences.en: So one half of me was taking the hits and the other half of me was taking notes.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的一半在承受打击，而另一半在做笔记。

sentences.en: And somehow that, in a sense, made me a writer very early where you're trying to understand why is she doing this to me.
sentences.zh: 不知何故，从某种意义上说，这让我很早就成了一名作家，你会试图理解她为什么要这样对我。

sentences.en: It was so often clear that it had nothing to do with what I had said or what I had done.
sentences.zh: 很多时候很明显，这与我说过什么或做过什么毫无关系。

sentences.en: It had something to do with something that I couldn't fully understand or control and was always struggling to understand and control.
sentences.zh: 这与一些我无法完全理解或控制的事情有关，而我一直在努力去理解和控制它。

sentences.en: I just want to give the audience just a sense of some of these incidents that you describe in the book.
sentences.zh: 我只是想让读者了解一下你在书中描述的一些事件。

sentences.en: Some of the moments that were hardest to read about were when she would berate you, belittle you.
sentences.zh: 最难读的一些片段是她责骂你、贬低你的时候。

sentences.en: You tell a story about being on a plane for the first time when you were about six years old.
sentences.zh: 你讲了一个关于你大约六岁时第一次坐飞机的故事。

sentences.en: Can you recount that story?
sentences.zh: 你能讲讲那个故事吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, my mother had an older sister who was very different from the rest of the family because she was the only one who had held her marriage together.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我母亲有一个姐姐，她和家里其他人很不一样，因为她是唯一一个维持住婚姻的人。

sentences.en: And she was married to someone who was a pilot who worked in Indian Airlines.
sentences.zh: 她嫁给了一个在印度航空公司工作的飞行员。

sentences.en: And she had, as I say, a proper house and a proper husband and proper children.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，她有一个像样的房子，一个像样的丈夫，还有像样的孩子。

sentences.en: And because this uncle of mine was a pilot, we had free tickets to get on a plane, which we had never been on.
sentences.zh: 因为我那位舅舅是飞行员，我们有免费机票可以坐飞机，那是我们从未坐过的。

sentences.en: And on the plane, I asked my mother, how come her sister was so much thinner than her?
sentences.zh: 在飞机上，我问母亲，为什么她的姐姐比她瘦那么多？

sentences.en: And my mother was, she was a very, very severe asthmatic.
sentences.zh: 我母亲，她是一个非常严重的哮喘患者。

sentences.en: And she was, at the time, in on steroids.
sentences.zh: 当时她正在服用类固醇。

sentences.en: And she had just become very overweight.
sentences.zh: 她变得非常超重。

sentences.en: And she had this moon face.
sentences.zh: 她有一张满月脸。

sentences.en: And she just turned on me in a fury and mimicked me.
sentences.zh: 她突然怒火中烧，模仿起我来。

sentences.en: You know, she had this way of mimicking my baby way of speaking.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她有一种模仿我婴儿说话方式的习惯。

sentences.en: And that used to just rip through me, you know.
sentences.zh: 那真的让我心如刀割，你知道。

sentences.en: And then she said, by the time you're my age, you'd be three times my size.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，等你到了我这个年纪，你会比我胖三倍。

sentences.en: And, of course, very quickly, she said, well, I'm your mother and your father.
sentences.zh: 当然，很快她又说，好吧，我既是你的母亲也是你的父亲。

sentences.en: And I love you double, you know.
sentences.zh: 我加倍爱你，你知道。

sentences.en: So you forgive her.
sentences.zh: 所以你原谅了她。

sentences.en: And yet, you're shredded also.
sentences.zh: 但同时，你也支离破碎了。

sentences.en: And so that was the constant, you know, thing that you had to manage.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是你必须应对的常态，你知道。

sentences.en: That something would tear you up and then stitch you back together.
sentences.zh: 有些东西会把你撕碎，然后再把你缝合起来。

sentences.en: Then tear you up.
sentences.zh: 然后又把你撕碎。

sentences.en: Then stitch you back together.
sentences.zh: 然后再把你缝合起来。

sentences.en: That leaves a lot of scars.
sentences.zh: 这留下了很多伤疤。

sentences.en: Well, it does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But maybe it also made me the writer that I am, you know.
sentences.zh: 但也许这也造就了今天的我，你知道。

sentences.en: You write that her mimicking you and calling you names made you feel that I swirled like water down a drain and disappeared.
sentences.zh: 你写道，她模仿你并给你起绰号，让你觉得“我像水流进下水道一样旋转着消失了”。

sentences.en: And I think that anyone who's had a difficult parent, which I have, can identify with that line.
sentences.zh: 我想任何有过难相处父母的人——我也有过——都能对这句话感同身受。

sentences.en: Did you think that you had to hide yourself, disappear when she was attacking you?
sentences.zh: 当她攻击你时，你是否觉得必须隐藏自己，让自己消失？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, it's not only that she was the only parent.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不仅仅是因为她是唯一的家长。

sentences.en: She was also the only person in a society and in a family that makes it clear that you're not part of it.
sentences.zh: 她也是在社会和家庭中唯一让你清楚地感觉到你不属于那里的人。

sentences.en: So she's all you have.
sentences.zh: 所以她是你拥有的一切。

sentences.en: I mean, there are no relatives.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，没有亲戚。

sentences.en: There are no neighbors.
sentences.zh: 没有邻居。

sentences.en: There's just nobody, you know.
sentences.zh: 真的谁都没有，你知道。

sentences.en: So for me, in some ways, I've welded myself to her, you know, when I was very young.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，在某种程度上，我很小的时候就把自己和她焊接在一起了，你知道。

sentences.en: And then exploded apart when I was older.
sentences.zh: 然后长大后又炸开了。

sentences.en: But, you know, she had these terrible attacks of asthma.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，她有严重的哮喘发作。

sentences.en: And she used to keep telling me, I'm going to die.
sentences.zh: 她过去常对我说，我要死了。

sentences.en: And you better figure out what you're going to do.
sentences.zh: 你最好想清楚你要怎么办。

sentences.en: You live on the street.
sentences.zh: 你流落街头。

sentences.en: Who's going to look after you?
sentences.zh: 谁来照顾你？

sentences.en: And so I became like her lung.
sentences.zh: 所以我成了她的肺。

sentences.en: You know, I used to breathe for her.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我过去常替她呼吸。

sentences.en: My body was an extension of her body.
sentences.zh: 我的身体是她身体的延伸。

sentences.en: And then when I was 16 and I went to architecture school and I just walked into those lawns and watched all the students.
sentences.zh: 后来我16岁时去了建筑学院，我走进那些草坪，看着所有的学生。

sentences.en: And I knew that I would be fine.
sentences.zh: 我知道我会没事的。

sentences.en: I would be able to work.
sentences.zh: 我能够工作。

sentences.en: I would be able to survive.
sentences.zh: 我能够生存。

sentences.en: I wouldn't die if she died.
sentences.zh: 如果她死了，我也不会死。

sentences.en: I didn't have to breathe for her.
sentences.zh: 我不必替她呼吸了。

sentences.en: And she sensed that the valiant organ child of hers, the lung, extra lung that she had, suddenly was breathing for itself.
sentences.zh: 她感觉到她那个勇敢的器官孩子，那个肺，她多出来的肺，突然开始为自己呼吸了。

sentences.en: And that generated a whole lot of hostility.
sentences.zh: 这引发了极大的敌意。

sentences.en: I just want to clarify that you ended up leaving your home at 16.
sentences.zh: 我只想澄清一下，你最终在16岁时离开了家。

sentences.en: There was a huge period of separation where you didn't see your mother at all.
sentences.zh: 有一段很长的分离期，你根本没见过你母亲。

sentences.en: And you basically raised yourself.
sentences.zh: 你基本上是靠自己长大的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I left Kerala to join architecture school when I was 16.
sentences.zh: 是的，我16岁时离开喀拉拉邦去读建筑学院。

sentences.en: And after my second year, I just stopped going home because it was too painful.
sentences.zh: 大二之后，我就不再回家了，因为那太痛苦了。

sentences.en: So I put myself through the rest of it.
sentences.zh: 所以我靠自己完成了剩下的学业。

sentences.en: And we should say that...
sentences.zh: 我们应该说……

sentences.en: Sorry, I just keep wanting to say that I don't want this to end up like some litany of, you know, horrors about her.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我只是总想说，我不希望这最终变成某种关于她的恐怖故事的冗长陈述。

sentences.en: Because as I keep saying in the book, I had huge admiration for her too.
sentences.zh: 因为正如我在书中一直提到的，我也非常钦佩她。

sentences.en: I mean, you talk about the battles that she was fighting even within the school.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你谈到了她甚至在学校内部所进行的斗争。

sentences.en: How she taught women and the men to look at gender dynamics in a completely different way.
sentences.zh: 她是如何教导女性和男性以一种完全不同的方式看待性别动态的。

sentences.en: I mean, you tell a story about her making the boys parade around in bras because one of them had disrespected one of the girls.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你讲过一个故事，说她让男生们穿上胸罩游行，因为其中一个男生不尊重女生。

sentences.en: Not parade around in bras, but...
sentences.zh: 不是穿上胸罩游行，而是……

sentences.en: Something similar.
sentences.zh: 类似的事情。

sentences.en: She learned that they were making fun of the girls because they'd started wearing bras.
sentences.zh: 她发现男生们在嘲笑女生，因为女生们开始穿胸罩了。

sentences.en: So she said, go to my cupboard and get my bra.
sentences.zh: 于是她说，去我的柜子里把我的胸罩拿来。

sentences.en: And then she showed them, she said, this is a bra.
sentences.zh: 然后她向他们展示，她说，这就是胸罩。

sentences.en: This is what it's for in assembly, you know.
sentences.zh: 这就是它在集会上的用途，你懂的。

sentences.en: And she said, if it excites you so much, you can keep mine.
sentences.zh: 她说，如果它让你们如此兴奋，那你们可以留着我的。

sentences.en: So it changed the pH balance of what goes on between boys and girls, you know, when the girls know that there's someone who's got their back.
sentences.zh: 所以这改变了男生和女生之间相处的化学反应，你知道，当女生知道有人在支持她们时。

sentences.en: One of the most interesting things in the book is how you write about gender dynamics.
sentences.zh: 书中一个最有趣的地方是你如何描写性别动态。

sentences.en: In the book, you describe India as the land of sun worshippers.
sentences.zh: 在书中，你将印度描述为太阳崇拜者的土地。

sentences.en: That's S-O-N.
sentences.zh: 是S-O-N（儿子）那个词。

sentences.en: But you also describe how harsh your mother was with your brother in particular.
sentences.zh: 但你也描述了你母亲对你哥哥尤其严厉。

sentences.en: I mean, she would call him a male chauvinist pig when he was only a child.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他还是个孩子时，她就叫他大男子主义猪。

sentences.en: When he was a teenager, she said to him, you know, you're ugly and stupid.
sentences.zh: 当他是青少年时，她对他说，你知道，你又丑又蠢。

sentences.en: You know, you should kill yourself.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你应该去自杀。

sentences.en: You write that the way she treated him was like she was punishing him for the sins of the world.
sentences.zh: 你写道，她对待他的方式，就像是在为世人的罪孽惩罚他。

sentences.en: And that that complicated your own views of feminism.
sentences.zh: 而这让你对女性主义的看法变得复杂。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering how that played out for you.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这对你产生了什么影响。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, even today, I think that my brother, he's one of the most amazing people that I know, you know, and having endured all that from her.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，即使在今天，我也认为我哥哥是我认识的最了不起的人之一，你知道，他忍受了她所做的一切。

sentences.en: My brother, the one that asked me, I don't understand how you can be so, so upset about her death after everything that she did to us.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥，那个问我的人，我不明白你怎么能在她对我们做了那么多事之后，还对她的死感到如此难过。

sentences.en: And I understand that it's very puzzling for him and perhaps even hurtful that I don't hate her, you know.
sentences.zh: 我理解这对他来说非常令人困惑，甚至可能很受伤，因为我不恨她，你懂的。

sentences.en: But I think it's just because I see that her public battles were making space for women in ways that included making space for me.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这只是因为我看到她的公开斗争为女性争取了空间，其中也包括为我争取了空间。

sentences.en: But at the same time, just because you're a feminist doesn't make you a great person, you know.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，仅仅因为你是女性主义者并不代表你就是一个伟大的人，你懂的。

sentences.en: Feminism doesn't have only to do with women's rights.
sentences.zh: 女性主义不仅仅与女性权利有关。

sentences.en: It has to do with a way of looking at the world in which men and women are equal and men and women are respectful of each other.
sentences.zh: 它关乎一种看待世界的方式，在这种方式中，男女平等，男女互相尊重。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean disrespecting a lovely man.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着不尊重一个可爱的男人。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean that.
sentences.zh: 并不是那个意思。

sentences.en: I think it's a very important thing, which is what I saw happening with my brother and which it affected me deeply.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一件非常重要的事情，这就是我看到发生在我哥哥身上的事，它深深地影响了我。

sentences.en: I want to just linger here for a moment because I am curious, because you and your brother saw your mother so differently, what the conversations around this book have been.
sentences.zh: 我想在这里多停留一会儿，因为我很好奇，因为你和你哥哥对你母亲的看法如此不同，关于这本书的讨论是怎样的。

sentences.en: I mean, has he read it and what has he thought of it?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他读过这本书吗？他怎么看？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, he has read it and I think it was hard initially for him to read because he, in a way, has, or maybe thought he had put it behind him.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，他读过了，我想起初他读起来很困难，因为在某种程度上，他已经，或者以为他已经把过去抛在脑后了。

sentences.en: But then he wrote to me saying, I'm laughing and crying and I can't breathe and if I die, it'll be your fault.
sentences.zh: 但后来他写信给我说，我边笑边哭，我无法呼吸，如果我死了，那都是你的错。

sentences.en: But then he did say, you know, I don't understand why you, you know,
sentences.zh: 但后来他确实说，你知道，我不明白为什么你，你知道，

sentences.en: feel so much about her because I said I can't hate her because there is so much of her in me I'd have to hate myself.
sentences.zh: 对她有这么多感觉，因为我说我不能恨她，因为我身上有太多她的影子，如果恨她，我就得恨我自己。

sentences.en: You know, I see that he's been, and I respect that he's been deeply, deeply hurt by her.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我看到他一直，我也尊重他一直被她深深地、深深地伤害。

sentences.en: But he, too, has made his life on his own and so both of us survived.
sentences.zh: 但他自己也活出了自己的人生，所以我们俩都活了下来。

sentences.en: There is this other moment that really struck me in the book where you describe you and your brother being sent to boarding school and you write that your brother got a report from school that said average student and your mother beat him with a ruler until it broke.
sentences.zh: 书中还有另一个时刻让我印象深刻，你描述了你和你哥哥被送去寄宿学校，你写道你哥哥收到学校的成绩单，上面写着“普通学生”，你母亲用尺子打他，直到尺子断掉。

sentences.en: And in the morning, she then turned to you and gave you a hug because your report card had been good and said that you were brilliant.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，她转过身来拥抱了你，因为你的成绩单很好，她说你很聪明。

sentences.en: And you wrote, on the occasions when I am toasted or applauded, I always feel that someone else, someone quiet, is being beaten in the other room.
sentences.zh: 你写道，每当我受到祝酒或鼓掌时，我总觉得另一个人，那个安静的人，正在隔壁房间挨打。

sentences.en: I have to say that stopped me in my tracks.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，那让我停下了脚步。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think the sentence after that is, if you stop to think about it, it's true, someone is.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想那之后的一句是，如果你停下来思考一下，这是真的，确实有人在挨打。

sentences.en: And actually, that is the truth, you know, that when you get applauded and rewarded and everybody claps and you know that somebody you love and somebody quiet has been beaten.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这就是事实，你知道，当你受到鼓掌和奖励，每个人都在拍手时，你知道你爱的人、那个安静的人正在挨打。

sentences.en: And to me, that expands far beyond my brother and me, it expands into the country that I live in now, you know, that or the world that I live in now, that I might be a writer with,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这远远超出了我和我哥哥，它扩展到了我现在居住的国家，你知道，或者我居住的世界，我可能是一个作家，拥有，

sentences.en: you know, whatever is conventionally known as success.
sentences.zh: 你知道，任何传统意义上的成功。

sentences.en: But the things I write about and the people that I write about are being beaten, they are being beaten down, even as we speak today, you know, they are being starved in Gaza,
sentences.zh: 但我所写的内容和我所写的人正在挨打，他们正在被殴打，即使在我们今天说话的时候，你知道，他们在加沙挨饿，

sentences.en: they are being broken, they are being occupied.
sentences.zh: 他们正在被摧毁，他们正在被占领。

sentences.en: And so what does it mean when you are applauded, when your heart belongs in the whole world?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你受到鼓掌，而你的心属于整个世界时，这意味着什么？

sentences.en: When you wrote that section and were thinking about that incident and how it applies to your life as someone who has been frequently publicly applauded and given so many awards,
sentences.zh: 当你写那一段，思考那个事件以及它如何适用于你作为一个经常在公开场合受到鼓掌并获得许多奖项的人的生活时，

sentences.en: was it a sense of discovery that this was the root of that connection?
sentences.zh: 这是一种发现吗，发现这就是那种联系的根源？

sentences.en: No, I mean, I don't think that the process of writing made me understand it deeper because I wrote it because I understood it, you know,
sentences.zh: 不，我是说，我不认为写作的过程让我更深刻地理解了它，因为我写它是因为我理解它，你知道，

sentences.en: in order to survive or in order to make sense of my life, I've had to think and think and think and think and think about all these things, you know.
sentences.zh: 为了生存，或者为了理清我的生活，我不得不思考、思考、再思考所有这些事情，你懂的。

sentences.en: So even, for example, when I won the Booker Prize and so on, there was like more than one half of me that was, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，即使在我获得布克奖等等的时候，我心里也有超过一半的部分是，你知道，

sentences.en: thinking about what does it mean to be this bestseller novelist in this country where people can't read, in this country where it's hurtling towards what we have now.
sentences.zh: 在思考，在这个人们无法阅读的国家，在这个正冲向我们现在所处境地的国家，成为畅销小说家意味着什么。

sentences.en: So there was hardly a moment for me to feel great about myself, you know, before things started to unravel quickly.
sentences.zh: 所以，在事情迅速瓦解之前，我几乎没有时间为自己感到高兴，你懂的。

sentences.en: And even the celebration of me had this whole nationalistic fervor, which I despised at that time in 97.
sentences.zh: 甚至对我的庆祝也带有一种民族主义狂热，我在97年时非常鄙视这一点。

sentences.en: So I was very quickly kicked off that pedestal and I kicked myself off it too.
sentences.zh: 所以我很快就被踢下了那个神坛，我自己也把自己踢了下来。

sentences.en: So I always have this feeling that those of us who've been very unsafe as children, we seek out the unsafe.
sentences.zh: 所以我总有一种感觉，我们这些童年非常不安全的人，会去寻找不安全感。

sentences.en: We seek out the lack of security.
sentences.zh: 我们寻找缺乏安全感的状态。

sentences.en: And if you have security, you blow it up.
sentences.zh: 如果你有了安全感，你就会把它炸掉。

sentences.en: I mean, you've risked your security many times in your career.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你在职业生涯中多次冒着失去安全的风险。

sentences.en: We should say that at the moment, actually, you are under legal threat in India for your writing and the things that you've said.
sentences.zh: 我们应该说，实际上此刻你在印度因为你的写作和你所说的话而面临法律威胁。

sentences.en: I mean, what do you think the role of writers and creators is at a moment when there is censorship and people are trying to shut you down?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你认为在审查制度存在、人们试图让你闭嘴的时候，作家和创作者的角色是什么？

sentences.en: I think that writers have survived, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为作家们已经活下来了，你知道，

sentences.en: whether it's in the Soviet Union or whether it's in East Germany or whether it's in the darkest places and times they have managed to survive.
sentences.zh: 无论是在苏联，还是在东德，还是在最黑暗的地方和时代，他们都设法活了下来。

sentences.en: Their work has survived.
sentences.zh: 他们的作品活了下来。

sentences.en: And it's, for me, very important to understand that I just can't keep striking the same note again and again.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，非常重要的一点是，我不能一直重复同样的调子。

sentences.en: You have to change it up, you know, you have to vary things, you have to experiment, you have to insist that your work is not just a reaction to what's happening to you.
sentences.zh: 你必须改变它，你知道，你必须变换事物，你必须实验，你必须坚持你的作品不仅仅是对发生在你身上事情的反应。

sentences.en: Your work is a thing in and of itself and a way of positing another vision of the world.
sentences.zh: 你的作品本身就是一种事物，是一种提出另一种世界愿景的方式。

sentences.en: And that's a challenge because you can't do it as a manifesto, as some clumsy, you know, hitting everybody on the head with some ideological hammer.
sentences.zh: 这是一个挑战，因为你不能把它当作宣言来做，不能像某种笨拙的、你知道，用某种意识形态的锤子敲打每个人的头那样。

sentences.en: You've got to do it beautifully.
sentences.zh: 你必须把它做得优美。

sentences.en: Somebody told me the other day that, oh, you know, the reason I like your writing is because you write as though they've already killed you.
sentences.zh: 前几天有人告诉我，哦，你知道，我喜欢你写作的原因是因为你写得好像他们已经杀了你一样。

sentences.en: You don't have, you don't hold back, you know, stuff for another book or another essay or something.
sentences.zh: 你没有，你没有保留，你知道，把东西留给下一本书或下一篇文章什么的。

sentences.en: Let's just put it all out there.
sentences.zh: 让我们把它全部写出来吧。

sentences.en: It's your epitaph.
sentences.zh: 这是你的墓志铭。

sentences.en: To bring this back to your mother,
sentences.zh: 回到你母亲的话题，

sentences.en: one of the things that I was most curious about is once you had this immense success and the pressures that it brought because of your nonfiction writing about the situation in Kashmir,
sentences.zh: 我最好奇的事情之一是，一旦你获得了巨大的成功，以及因为你关于克什米尔局势的非虚构写作、

sentences.en: about huge dam operations and many of the other issues that you have passionately written about, including the rise of Hindu nationalism in India.
sentences.zh: 关于大型水坝工程以及你热情撰写的许多其他议题（包括印度印度教民族主义的兴起）所带来的压力，

sentences.en: How did she view that?
sentences.zh: 她是怎么看的？

sentences.en: Was she worried for you?
sentences.zh: 她为你担心吗？

sentences.en: Was she proud of you?
sentences.zh: 她为你骄傲吗？

sentences.en: Was she jealous of you?
sentences.zh: 她嫉妒你吗？

sentences.en: You know, of all the people that I know in my family, she's the one who used to read it, especially every political essay, and she used to follow it closely.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在我认识的家人中，她是那个会读它的人，尤其是每一篇政治文章，她会密切关注。

sentences.en: I know that she was worried, but not because she told me she was worried, but because other people in the school used to tell me she's worried.
sentences.zh: 我知道她很担心，但不是因为她告诉我她很担心，而是因为学校里的其他人告诉我她很担心。

sentences.en: But to me, she was always like, what the hell do you think you're doing?
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，她总是说，你以为你在做什么？

sentences.en: And, you know, whatever, very dismissive.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，无论如何，非常不屑一顾。

sentences.en: But perhaps she also had as unresolved feelings about me as I did for her, because once she called me up to say that, you know, I went to buy some fruit.
sentences.zh: 但也许她对我也有和我对她一样未解决的情感，因为有一次她打电话给我说，你知道，我去买水果。

sentences.en: And that woman asked me, are you Arundhati Roy's mother?
sentences.zh: 那个女人问我，你是阿兰达蒂·罗伊的母亲吗？

sentences.en: And I felt as though she had slapped me.
sentences.zh: 我感觉就像她打了我一巴掌。

sentences.en: And she called me to tell me this, you know.
sentences.zh: 她打电话告诉我这件事，你懂的。

sentences.en: And at the same time, she was also proud because I was not just her daughter, I was also a product of her school.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，她也很骄傲，因为我不仅是她的女儿，我还是她学校的产品。

sentences.en: So I think she had her moments when she was very, very ill.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为她在病得很重的时候也有过那样的时刻。

sentences.en: She used to get very upset if I wasn't there in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 如果我不在医院，她会非常难过。

sentences.en: But if I was there, she would say, oh, these people, they're just coming here because of you.
sentences.zh: 但如果我在那里，她会说，哦，这些人，他们只是因为你才来这里的。

sentences.en: They don't care about me.
sentences.zh: 他们不在乎我。

sentences.en: And, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道。

sentences.en: How did that make you feel that she seemed to have a complicated relationship with you, even as you became an enormous success?
sentences.zh: 当你变得如此成功时，她似乎与你有着复杂的关系，这让你感觉如何？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, as we've spoken before, you know, success was in itself without her and her opinions a complicated thing for me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，正如我们之前谈过的，你知道，成功本身，抛开她和她的观点，对我来说就是一件复杂的事情。

sentences.en: But, you know, occasionally it used to break my heart that she had such a thorny, you know, response to it.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，偶尔她对此有那种带刺的、你知道，反应，这让我心碎。

sentences.en: But at the same time, I always was very clear in my mind that I never wanted to defeat her.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我心里一直很清楚，我从没想过要打败她。

sentences.en: Like I wanted her to go out like a queen, which she did.
sentences.zh: 就像我希望她像女王一样离开，她确实做到了。

sentences.en: And, you know, that involved reducing myself sometimes.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这有时需要贬低我自己。

sentences.en: That involved being mauled and shredded and having to piece myself together sometimes.
sentences.zh: 这有时需要被蹂躏、被撕碎，然后不得不把自己拼凑起来。

sentences.en: Sometimes that involved calibrating how many days I could be there before I was absolutely corroded.
sentences.zh: 有时这需要权衡我能在那里待几天，才不会被彻底腐蚀。

sentences.en: It involved coming home and being quite sick physically for a long time just to get over it, you know.
sentences.zh: 这需要回家后身体上病很久才能恢复过来，你懂的。

sentences.en: But at the same time, somehow I had that ability to detach myself and sit on the ceiling fan and think,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，不知何故，我有那种能力让自己抽离出来，坐在天花板的风扇上思考，

sentences.en: God, this is quite funny, the whole thing, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 天哪，这很有趣，不是吗？

sentences.en: You know, so I think that sort of saved me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，所以我认为那种方式拯救了我。

sentences.en: And also because I, the more I travel, the more I saw of the world, the more I wrote about things that were happening,
sentences.zh: 而且因为我，我旅行得越多，看到的世界越多，我写的事情越多，

sentences.en: the less able I was to put myself at the center of some great tragedy.
sentences.zh: 我就越不能把自己置于某种巨大悲剧的中心。

sentences.en: You know, I was just like, it's okay.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只是觉得，没关系。

sentences.en: Things are bad elsewhere, you know.
sentences.zh: 其他地方情况更糟，你知道。

sentences.en: Well, we are going to speak again in a short time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们很快会再谈。

sentences.en: And I want to talk more about your political writing, your activism, and the situation in India.
sentences.zh: 我想更多地谈谈你的政治写作、你的行动主义以及印度的局势。

sentences.en: And we'll pick up there.
sentences.zh: 我们会在那里继续。

sentences.en: But I want to thank you so much for this conversation.
sentences.zh: 但我非常感谢你这次谈话。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It's my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Can I ask you one more question, actually?
sentences.zh: 我可以再问你一个问题吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: Is it hard to talk about this?
sentences.zh: 谈论这些很难吗？

sentences.en: I'm, I'm just learning to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我，我正在学习谈论它。

sentences.en: I can see your physical self when I ask certain questions and it might be uncomfortable territory, I imagine.
sentences.zh: 当我问某些问题时，我能看到你的身体反应，我想那可能是不舒服的领域。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I, I, I read the audio book and the audio engineer, producer, he told me, you know, it's okay, you can take some breaks.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，我，我读了有声书，音频工程师、制作人告诉我，你知道，没关系，你可以休息一下。

sentences.en: And if you get upset, I said, me, why would I get upset?
sentences.zh: 如果你难过的话，我说，我？我为什么要难过？

sentences.en: I wrote it, I lived it, you know, I'm going to get upset.
sentences.zh: 我写了它，我经历了它，你知道，我会难过的。

sentences.en: He says, oh, well, the last third of the book, your voice is completely different from the first two thirds.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，好吧，书的最后三分之一，你的声音和前三分之二完全不同。

sentences.en: So, I have to see, you know, how it goes.
sentences.zh: 所以，我得看看，你知道，进展如何。

sentences.en: I think, to me, it's important that people don't think that this is just a book about a mother and a daughter.
sentences.zh: 我认为，对我来说，重要的是人们不要认为这只是一本关于母亲和女儿的书。

sentences.en: Because this is a book about two women who happen to be mother and daughter, but it's also about the village and the city and the state and the country and the world.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一本关于两个恰好是母女的女性的书，但它也关于村庄、城市、国家、国家和世界。

sentences.en: And if it weren't that, it would not be as important to me.
sentences.zh: 如果不是这样，它对我来说就不会那么重要了。

sentences.en: After the break, I talk to Arundhati again, and I ask her about the parallels she sees between Indian politics and American politics.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我再次与阿兰达蒂交谈，我问她关于她在印度政治和美国政治之间看到的相似之处。

sentences.en: I look at it in shock because you thought that there was a mechanism in place, there were checks and balances in place.
sentences.zh: 我震惊地看着它，因为你以为有一个机制在运作，有制衡机制在运作。

sentences.en: But clearly, there isn't a way of handling someone who's completely out of control.
sentences.zh: 但显然，没有办法处理一个完全失控的人。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是Winnalou。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是Sam Azersky，我每天创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到的那些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Hi, nice to see you again.
sentences.zh: 嗨，很高兴再次见到你。

sentences.en: Hey, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 嘿，露露。

sentences.en: Nice to see you too.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: You know, after we spoke last time and we talked a little bit about the political situation in India and the situation for you in particular,
sentences.zh: 你知道，上次我们交谈时，聊了一些关于印度的政治局势，特别是你所处的境况，

sentences.en: just in the past few days, the Indian regional government of Kashmir has banned one of your books.
sentences.zh: 就在过去几天里，印度克什米尔地区政府封禁了你的一本书。

sentences.en: And of course, this is not the first time your work has been targeted.
sentences.zh: 当然，这已经不是你的作品第一次成为目标了。

sentences.en: This time, the book is Azadi.
sentences.zh: 这次被禁的书是《阿扎迪》（Azadi）。

sentences.en: It was published in 2020.
sentences.zh: 它出版于2020年。

sentences.en: It's about the fight in Indian-controlled Kashmir, the concepts behind freedom and authoritarianism more broadly.
sentences.zh: 书中探讨了印度控制下的克什米尔地区的抗争，以及更广泛意义上关于自由和威权主义的概念。

sentences.en: And I'm going to quote what the directive said.
sentences.zh: 我来引用一下那份指令的内容。

sentences.en: It said that your book and others, it wasn't the only one that was targeted, would, quote,
sentences.zh: 它称你的书以及其他被针对的书籍（不止这一本），会，引用：

sentences.en: deeply impact the psyche of youth by promoting a culture of grievance, victimhood, and terrorist heroism.
sentences.zh: “通过宣扬不满、受害者心态和恐怖主义英雄主义的文化，深刻影响年轻人的心理”。

sentences.en: Why do you think your book was included in that list?
sentences.zh: 你认为为什么你的书会被列入那个名单？

sentences.en: And what's your response to that more broadly?
sentences.zh: 对于这一点，你更广泛的回应是什么？

sentences.en: You know, my response to it is to not respond because, I don't know, it sounds like some list they got out of chat, GPT or something.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的回应就是不予回应，因为，我不知道，这听起来像是他们从 ChatGPT 之类的地方弄出来的名单。

sentences.en: You never know why these things happen when they happen.
sentences.zh: 你永远不知道这些事情为什么会发生，或者什么时候发生。

sentences.en: And when they target me now, I just don't say anything because you never know whether they really mean it or it's just some side game to distract from something or whatever.
sentences.zh: 当他们现在针对我时，我只是什么都不说，因为你永远不知道他们是认真的，还是仅仅为了转移注意力而搞的某种旁门左道，或者其他什么原因。

sentences.en: So I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 所以我毫无头绪。

sentences.en: So I'm not going to say much about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我对此没什么可说的。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: As we mentioned in our first conversation, you are currently under threat of arrest in India for comments you made about Kashmir in 2010.
sentences.zh: 正如我们在第一次谈话中提到的，你目前在印度面临逮捕威胁，原因是你2010年对克什米尔发表的评论。

sentences.en: I mean, for our audience, do you feel comfortable explaining your position?
sentences.zh: 我是说，对于我们的听众，你愿意解释一下你的立场吗？

sentences.en: And can you tell me a little bit about the status of that legal case?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我说说那起法律案件的现状吗？

sentences.en: I really don't want to talk about it, actually, because, you know, it just increases the risk of something being taken out of context and something blowing up.
sentences.zh: 其实我真的不想谈论它，因为，你知道，这只会增加某些言论被断章取义并引发事端的风险。

sentences.en: It's dormant right now.
sentences.zh: 它现在处于搁置状态。

sentences.en: So I just let it be, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是让它顺其自然，你知道的。

sentences.en: Then let me ask you this, because even the manner in which you're responding,
sentences.zh: 那让我问你这个问题，因为即使是你回应的方式，

sentences.en: which is that you do not want to address this because of the fear of legal repercussions that could even mean jail and other punishments.
sentences.zh: 即因为担心可能导致入狱或其他惩罚的法律后果，而不愿谈论此事。

sentences.en: What does that say when governments try and silence authors, writers, academics regarding their work and what they try and put out in the world?
sentences.zh: 当政府试图压制作者、作家、学者关于其作品以及他们试图向世界传达的内容时，这说明了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I think in America, you're beginning to head in that direction.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为在美国，你们也开始朝着那个方向发展了。

sentences.en: Ours started a long time ago, and one has to learn how to navigate it.
sentences.zh: 我们的情况很久以前就开始了，一个人必须学会如何应对它。

sentences.en: And the reason that I don't talk about it is because I would much rather write what I want to write than have some controversy about something you just say off the cuff.
sentences.zh: 我不谈论它的原因是因为，比起因为随口说的一句话而引发争议，我更愿意写我想写的东西。

sentences.en: It's like they're always trying to trip people up and trying to prevent you from thinking clearly.
sentences.zh: 就像他们总是试图给人们设陷阱，试图阻止你清晰地思考。

sentences.en: And so this culture of fear is everywhere here.
sentences.zh: 所以这种恐惧文化在这里无处不在。

sentences.en: You know, now people are arrested for things they say on Facebook, on Twitter or what they don't say.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现在人们因为在 Facebook、Twitter 上说的话，或者因为没说的话而被捕。

sentences.en: Like in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 就像在美国，

sentences.en: it seems new to you, but we have been living with this and it's increasingly becoming normalized.
sentences.zh: 这看起来对你来说很新鲜，但我们一直生活在这种环境中，而且它正日益常态化。

sentences.en: And it's a very disturbing situation and especially disturbing, obviously, for Muslims, where it doesn't stop with just, you know, court cases and jail.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常令人不安的局面，显然对穆斯林来说尤其令人不安，因为这不仅仅止于法庭诉讼和监禁，你知道的。

sentences.en: It goes on to lynching and murder and social boycotts and economic boycotts and their homes being bulldozed.
sentences.zh: 它还会演变成私刑、谋杀、社会抵制、经济抵制，以及他们的家园被推土机夷为平地。

sentences.en: So one thing leads to another, to another, to another, and you end up being in a situation where you meet people who have stories that you can't look away from.
sentences.zh: 所以一件事接着一件事，没完没了，最终你发现自己处于一种境地，你会遇到那些有着让你无法移开视线的经历的人。

sentences.en: This thing is, I think, seminal to your work.
sentences.zh: 我认为这件事对你的作品至关重要。

sentences.en: You know, when you have seen injustice, you have not been able to look away.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你目睹了不公，你就无法移开视线。

sentences.en: Many people do look away.
sentences.zh: 很多人确实移开了视线。

sentences.en: What do you think it is about you that makes you not flinch?
sentences.zh: 你认为是什么让你能够直面这一切而不退缩？

sentences.en: Actually, I think the point is that I do flinch when I see it.
sentences.zh: 其实，我认为重点在于，当我看到不公时，我确实会退缩。

sentences.en: And most people don't flinch.
sentences.zh: 而大多数人不会退缩。

sentences.en: They just accept it as a part of daily injustices.
sentences.zh: 他们只是将其视为日常不公的一部分而接受了。

sentences.en: And the thing is that India is a society that is built on a social hierarchy, which is amongst the most cruel in the world.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，印度是一个建立在社会等级制度之上的社会，这种制度是世界上最残酷的制度之一。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，

sentences.en: we have a situation where people are divided up hierarchically according to what is considered levels of purity and impurity and the dehumanization of people who are considered outcasts,
sentences.zh: 我们面临的情况是，人们根据所谓的纯洁与不纯洁的等级被划分开来，那些被视为贱民的人被非人化，

sentences.en: which has been actually institutionalized.
sentences.zh: 这实际上已经被制度化了。

sentences.en: So it's a society that accepts injustice as a given.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个将不公视为理所当然的社会。

sentences.en: You touched on this a little,
sentences.zh: 你稍微提到了这一点，

sentences.en: and so I would love to hear your thoughts on how you view parallels between the Hindu nationalist movement in India and the MAGA movement here in the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以我很想听听你对印度印度教民族主义运动与美国“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）运动之间相似之处的看法。

sentences.en: There are a lot of parallels.
sentences.zh: 有很多相似之处。

sentences.en: So one of the first things that happened when Modi came to power was demonetization, this direct hit on the economy where he said 500 rupee notes were illegal, like overnight.
sentences.zh: 莫迪上台后发生的第一件事就是废钞令，这对经济造成了直接打击，他一夜之间宣布500卢比面值的纸币非法。

sentences.en: You know, if you look at the attack on citizenship, the attack on universities, the attack on students, the attack on Rohingyas, the continuous uncertainty,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你看看对公民身份的攻击、对大学的攻击、对学生的攻击、对罗兴亚人的攻击，以及持续的不确定性，

sentences.en: the fact that you might be ambushed by anything at any time.
sentences.zh: 事实上你可能随时随地遭到伏击。

sentences.en: It's so similar that you wonder, is there a playbook or is it just osmotic authoritarian behavior?
sentences.zh: 这太相似了，以至于你会怀疑，是不是有一本剧本，还是这仅仅是渗透性的威权行为？

sentences.en: And of course, there are other things like voter suppression.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有其他事情，比如选民压制。

sentences.en: The leader of the opposition had a huge expose of how voter lists have been manipulated.
sentences.zh: 反对派领导人曾大规模揭露选民名单是如何被操纵的。

sentences.en: So basically what you're seeing is that the ruling party is confused with government and all of it is confused with one man.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上你看到的是，执政党与政府混为一谈，而这一切又与一个人混为一谈。

sentences.en: You know, so you're seeing that in the US and I look at it in shock because you thought that there was a mechanism in place, there were checks and balances in place.
sentences.zh: 你知道，所以你在美国也看到了这一点，我感到震惊，因为你原以为那里有现成的机制，有现成的制衡体系。

sentences.en: But clearly there isn't a way of handling someone who's completely out of control, you know,
sentences.zh: 但显然，对于一个完全失控的人，并没有什么应对办法，你知道的，

sentences.en: and the way statisticians are being fired for giving out figures that the authoritarian doesn't agree with.
sentences.zh: 还有统计学家因为发布威权者不认同的数据而被解雇的方式。

sentences.en: Same thing here, you can't believe any of the government figures on economics because everything that doesn't suit the ruling establishment is dismissed,
sentences.zh: 这里也一样，你不能相信任何政府的经济数据，因为所有不符合执政当局利益的东西都会被驳回，

sentences.en: it's thrown away and a new picture is put in its place.
sentences.zh: 被扔掉，然后用一幅新的图景取而代之。

sentences.en: The one big difference between what's happening in India and what is happening right now in the US is that in India, the mainstream media has completely compromised.
sentences.zh: 印度正在发生的事情与美国目前正在发生的事情之间最大的区别在于，在印度，主流媒体已经完全妥协了。

sentences.en: It's not just rolled over, it is actually an organ of the authoritarian state, it's actually calling for people's arrest or making up lies.
sentences.zh: 它不仅仅是屈服，它实际上已经成为威权国家的喉舌，它甚至在呼吁逮捕民众或编造谎言。

sentences.en: And of course, America sitting on top of a crumbling world, whatever Trump does affects the whole world, whereas here, it just affects this country.
sentences.zh: 当然，美国处于摇摇欲坠的世界之巅，特朗普所做的一切都会影响整个世界，而在这里，它只影响这个国家。

sentences.en: Why do you think authoritarian leaders go after people like you, people who deal in ideas?
sentences.zh: 你认为为什么威权领导人要针对像你这样的人，那些从事思想工作的人？

sentences.en: When you said there's like an echo of a playbook, I mean, we've seen that, yes, in places all around the world, I've covered it.
sentences.zh: 当你提到有一种剧本的回响时，我的意思是，我们已经在世界各地看到了这一点，我报道过。

sentences.en: From time immemorial.
sentences.zh: 从古至今皆是如此。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But as someone who's the subject of that kind of censure, I'm wondering why you think it happens.
sentences.zh: 但作为那种审查的对象，我很好奇你认为为什么会发生这种情况。

sentences.en: I think they are terrified of people who they feel like can communicate, not just cerebrally, but emotionally and otherwise with people, you know.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们害怕那些他们觉得能够沟通的人，不仅是在理智上，而且在情感上以及其他方面与人们沟通，你知道的。

sentences.en: So people who can, even however small they are, and even however little access they have to the mainstream or to the thundering, pulpit thumping television anchors,
sentences.zh: 所以那些能够做到这一点的人，无论他们多么渺小，无论他们接触主流媒体或那些雷鸣般、敲着讲坛的电视主播的机会多么少，

sentences.en: they know that there are some people who somehow people eventually do listen to.
sentences.zh: 他们知道，总有一些人是人们最终会去倾听的。

sentences.en: They know it, you know, they know who is read, they know who is loved, they know also who is not invested in the things that everyone else is invested in.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这一点，你知道，他们知道谁被阅读，他们知道谁被爱戴，他们也知道谁没有投入到其他人所投入的事情中去。

sentences.en: You know, it's not just about fame and money and awards and whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这不仅仅是关于名声、金钱、奖项或其他什么东西。

sentences.en: You know, there's something else going on.
sentences.zh: 你知道，还有其他事情在发生。

sentences.en: And there are a lot of people like that who they know just will not bow down.
sentences.zh: 而且有很多人像那样，他们知道这些人就是不会屈服。

sentences.en: I think what you're referring to in part is people like yourself who also deal with emotional truth.
sentences.zh: 我想你所指的部分是像你这样也处理情感真相的人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Not just facts, but being able to capture ideas that resonate on a different level.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是事实，而是能够捕捉到在不同层面上产生共鸣的思想。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you see, you know, I mean, it's really interesting because now you see the government moving to capture Bollywood.
sentences.zh: 你看，你知道，我的意思是，这真的很有趣，因为现在你看到政府正在采取行动控制宝莱坞。

sentences.en: And one after another, after another, they churn out these absolutely hateful films, hateful, violent, literally almost evil filMs.
sentences.zh: 他们一部接一部地炮制出这些绝对充满仇恨的电影，充满仇恨、暴力，简直几乎是邪恶的电影。

sentences.en: But they just don't work.
sentences.zh: 但它们就是行不通。

sentences.en: In our first conversation, when I asked you about how you see the role of artists in turbulent moments, you said something that struck me.
sentences.zh: 在我们第一次谈话中，当我问你如何看待艺术家在动荡时刻的角色时，你说了一些让我印象深刻的话。

sentences.en: You have to insist that your work is not just a reaction to what's happening to you.
sentences.zh: 你必须坚持认为你的作品不仅仅是对发生在你身上的事情的反应。

sentences.en: Is that feeling specific to your fiction?
sentences.zh: 这种感觉对你的小说来说是特定的吗？

sentences.en: Because you're, as we've said, a very prolific political writer.
sentences.zh: 因为正如我们所说，你是一位非常多产的政治作家。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But maybe that work feels different.
sentences.zh: 但也许那部作品感觉不同。

sentences.en: That work is different because that work is often an argument that is made at a time when things are closing down.
sentences.zh: 那部作品不同，因为那部作品通常是在事物正在封闭时所作出的论证。

sentences.en: When I see the media, the government, everybody sort of closing in on a vulnerable community or lie about them, pretend that they are what they are not and so on.
sentences.zh: 当我看到媒体、政府，每个人都在某种程度上围攻一个弱势群体，或者对他们撒谎，假装他们不是他们所是的样子等等。

sentences.en: And it's really like trying to blow a space open, you know, that I would go in.
sentences.zh: 这真的就像试图吹开一个空间，你知道，我可以进去。

sentences.en: And almost all the essays are written despite my telling myself, I'm not going to do it.
sentences.zh: 而且几乎所有的文章都是在我不顾自己的告诫下写出来的，我告诉自己，我不会去写。

sentences.en: I'm not going to do it.
sentences.zh: 我不会去写。

sentences.en: Because you get into so much trouble after.
sentences.zh: 因为事后你会惹上很多麻烦。

sentences.en: And then when it just becomes harder to keep quiet than to write, I write.
sentences.zh: 然后当保持沉默变得比写作更困难时，我就写了。

sentences.en: And for me, it's not about the product or how many books I write.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这与产品或我写了多少本书无关。

sentences.en: I'm not interested in that output being huge.
sentences.zh: 我对那种巨大的产出不感兴趣。

sentences.en: I am interested in living the life of a writer, which does not involve just sitting and writing.
sentences.zh: 我感兴趣的是过一种作家的生活，这不仅仅包括坐下来写作。

sentences.en: It involves a lot of living, a lot of listening, a lot of traveling, a lot of inhabiting worlds and worlds and worlds, you know, which is why I love this place.
sentences.zh: 它包括很多生活、很多倾听、很多旅行、很多栖居于一个又一个的世界，你知道，这就是为什么我喜欢这个地方。

sentences.en: Because there's so much about it that I still don't know.
sentences.zh: 因为关于它，我还有很多不知道的事情。

sentences.en: That's Arundhati Roy.
sentences.zh: 那是阿兰达蒂·罗伊（Arundhati Roy）。
